name: XLA_EVENT_SOURCES
description: This table connects sources and event classes.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of source application.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is predefined by subledger application.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the source is assigned to the event class.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Level of the standard source assignment. The possible values are H for Header, L for Line, and C for Currency.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: The column name which stores the source value in the transactions table.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: The transaction table name which stores the source value.

columns.name: SPLIT_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is used as a criteria when spitting large transactions.

columns.name: SUMMARIZATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is used to summarize source transaction lines.
